notice.started: Your plan guides new genetic draws.
notice.perfect: 100% survival! Resume to continue the experiment.
speech.intro_gerard: René, I put on my serious shirt. We can begin.
speech.intro_rene: The lemons command respect. The protocol awaits.
speech.start: Let’s go. Full throttle. I cleared my afternoon.
speech.reveal_gerard: Wait… your paradise is a tiny slit!
speech.reveal_rene: The rightmost five percent. They also had to move. A selective welcome.
speech.perfect_gerard: Everyone made it! 240 out of 240! René, a full house!
speech.after_perfect: René! Did you SEE that? Every last one! I sit down for two seconds and I want to jump up again. That is why we watch!
speech.after_ninetyfive: Look left, look right — they are finding their way! René, tell me you saw that finish. We might have a prodigy here!
speech.perfect_rene: One hundred percent. No casualties. I am pausing the protocol to savor this result.

behavior.turn_help: Turns at a fixed strength of 1 rad/s. Direction can evolve; strength is shared by both teams.
behavior.thrust_help: Forward thrust: 220 u/s² before energy limits. The same fixed strength for both teams.
behavior.direction_help: Pushes along an inherited world angle: 44 u/s² for both teams. The angle mutates; force does not. No target or region sensing.

speech.ninetyfive: Ninety-five percent! Now that is a generation worth standing up for.
speech.ninetyfive_rene: {0} reached {1:0.0}% survival. A strong result; the remaining agents still matter.

speech.follow: I am following that little wanderer. A promising direction… or a very confident mistake.
speech.direction_coach: They do not know where safety is. They inherit a direction; selection keeps the ones that work.
speech.calm_gerard: Somewhere in there is the next prodigy. I have time. Let us watch.
